verdict.rationale: Docs show all the building blocks needed—system prompting (docs-7), voice/TTS+STT config, Twilio telephony integration with step-by-step guide (docs-18, docs-19), and quickstart guides in multiple languages plus starter templates (docs-24, docs-25)—which together plausibly enable a phone agent to go live quickly. However, there is no explicit 'under an hour' benchmark or independent/hands-on report confirming the time-to-first-call, and phone number acquisition still requires a third-party (Twilio) setup outside Deepgram's own docs. Missing for 10: an end-to-end time-boxed tutorial or case study, independent developer corroboration of setup speed, and native phone-number provisioning within Deepgram itself.
